description:
Han-Eul, exhausted from a long job search, is suddenly visited by a stranger who introduces himself as "God." 

"God" says that if he works as Han-Eul's representative for a certain period of time, he will be released and help him land a job at the company of his choice. Having experienced various strange things, Han-Eul begins to worry. Is he really God? Even if he isn't God, is there anything he can do if it's not this? After all, isn't someone who seems so kind a bad person? Amidst the confusion, one thing is certain: the person before him is no ordinary human. So, should he pretend to be crazy just for once and believe?

*"Representative... How does that work?"*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
